decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the core map.apps platform and was improved through several quick releases, so the firm can keep developing it cheaply even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

The hierarchical search bundle is close to the firm's existing knowledge and cheap to maintain, but its low visibility and missing presence after 2018 suggest it may be merged into the general search functions.
VueTOC was an experimental mobile control component that has not reappeared since its launch, so the firm has likely absorbed what it learned into other products and freed the resources.
The flagship GIS platform rests directly on the firm's core engineering knowledge, research and standards work, and it anchors the firm's strategic direction.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's GIS competence and serves both public and private customers, which justifies continued investment despite lower visibility.
The search extension complements the firm's web map applications using knowledge it already holds, though some overlap with other search components creates a moderate risk of consolidation.
